# Meta_Residual_Learning

**Domain**: iNEST
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
A training framework where residual mappings are learned at a higher abstraction level (meta-level) to adaptively modulate the contribution of skip connections in SNNs. This provides a flexible mechanism for balancing feature reuse and new learning in iNEST, enhancing the capacity of neuromorphic hardware to handle complex temporal patterns.
